scripts.gen: pnpm --filter @cat-chat/web gen && cd apps/api && go generate ./...
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && set -a && { [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; } && set +a && INSECURE_COOKIES=1 DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres:///catchat?host=/tmp} go run ./cmd/server
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cat-chat/web build && cd apps/api && go build ./...
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cat-chat/web test && cd apps/api && TEST_DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgres:///catchat_test?host=/tmp} go test ./...
scripts.lint: biome check . && cd apps/api && go vet ./...
